description: Auxilliary Clone Expander: adds four more cloned polyphonic input and output pairs to a Clone Merge, Poly Clone or Poly Unison, and goes immediately to the right of it

params.text: Sets the channel order at the output of the same number: yellow keeps all the copies of one input channel together, blue lays out the input channels as a set and repeats the whole set

inputs.text: A polyphonic signal copied by the parent module's clone count and carried to the output of the same number; unpatched it counts as one channel of 0V

outputs.text: Carries the input of the same number copied to the parent's channel count; its lamp is yellow when every channel copied, orange when missing ones were filled with 0V, red when extra ones were dropped

notes: with a Poly Unison as the parent these outputs are copied but not detuned, and a lamp glows yellow while the module is connected to a parent
